title: Test compute_signals against the worked example
goal: The eight signals are the contract this whole tool exists to serve, and brief 0002 acceptance item 6 requires them to match the driver exactly. This task adds the tests that pin them, so a later change that quietly alters a derivation cannot pass unnoticed.
acceptance: tests/test_signals.py asserts each of the eight signal values for the worked-example fixture
The assertions compare against the literal expected values from the brief (3, 2/8, 1.50, 1, 0, 1, 0, $4.08)
A change to any derivation in signals.py would fail at least one test
